entries.query_shape: SELECT count(), countIf(JSONHas(json,'branch_id')), countIf(JSONExtractInt(json,'branch_id') != 0) FROM zod.public_hotlist_json WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0

entries.aggregate_result: total_rows=95542923; rows_with_branch_id_key=0; rows_with_nonzero_branch_id=0
entries.why: PRIMARY EVIDENCE. hotlist_json.json['branch_id'] is the single source that feeds every downstream branch_id column. Zero of 95.5M live rows carry the key at all, proving GetOrgHotlistCaseInfo (its only writer) has never run in production.

entries.query_shape: SELECT create_table_query FROM system.tables WHERE database IN ('clarity','zod') AND name LIKE '%_mv'
entries.aggregate_result: branch_id propagation chain verified end-to-end: hotlist_json.json['branch_id'] -> zod.hotlist_json_denormalized_mv (JSONExtract) -> clarity.hotlist_incremental_mv (changed-set UNIONs hotlist_json_denormalized on its OWN watermark) -> clarity.hotlist -> recoveries_mv / missed_opportunities_mv (read h.branch_id from clarity.hotlist) -> client_days_to_repo_mv (reads r.branch_id from clarity.recoveries).
entries.why: Answers Q5 (cross-repo propagation). The chain EXISTS and is correctly wired for branch_id - the MV layer is not implicated in the bug.

entries.query_shape: SELECT create_table_query FROM system.tables WHERE database='clarity' AND name='hotlist_status_aggregate_mv'
entries.aggregate_result: REFRESH EVERY 15 MINUTE APPEND TO clarity.hotlist_status_aggregate. Its changed-set is driven SOLELY by zod.public_hotlist_status_log WHERE _peerdb_synced_at >= watermark; hj_deduped (the branch_id join) is itself restricted to hotlist_ids appearing in that same status-log window.
entries.why: CRITICAL CONSTRAINT ON OPTION A: backfilling hotlist_json.branch_id will NOT retroactively populate clarity.hotlist_status_aggregate. Only hotlists whose STATUS LOG rows sync after the backfill pick up the new branch_id, and because the MV is APPEND TO, historical aggregate rows keep branch_id=0 permanently. The stat cards backed by this table would still read 0 for historical data after a successful platform-side backfill.

entries.query_shape: SELECT k, count() FROM zod.public_hotlist_json ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractKeys(json) AS k WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted=0 GROUP BY k ORDER BY count() DESC
entries.aggregate_result: 21 distinct keys. case_number=91,209,893; vehicle_color=87,573,754; description=81,546,891; entering_agency=57,322,782; expires_at=12,025,695; plate_type/file_type_decode/plate_expired_at/title_number=2,776,976 each; vin=88,188; vehicle_type=71,588; vehicle_year/model/make=18,675 each; long tail to 1.
entries.why: BLAST RADIUS OF A LATENT DATA-DESTRUCTION BUG. GetOrgHotlistCaseInfo.php:88-91 rebuilds the whole blob via HotlistJsonData::from(), and that DTO declares ONLY ?int $branch_id - so Spatie discards every undeclared key and save() writes back {branch_id} alone. Restoring the dispatch without fixing this first would irreversibly wipe all 21 keys from every row it touched. Verified in code + quantified here.

entries.query_shape: SELECT count(), countIf(first_open_at IS NOT NULL), countIf(first_repossessed_at IS NOT NULL), countIf(branch_id>0) FROM clarity.hotlist FINAL WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted=0 AND created_at >= now()-90d; + same GROUP BY toYear(created_at)
entries.aggregate_result: 90d: 4,812,060 rows, first_open_at 4,255,274 (88%, NULLs are never-Open statuses 90/99/5), first_repossessed_at 681,997, branch_id>0 = 0. Backfilled to 2022 (2023: 5.44M/6.05M have first_open_at).

entries.query_shape: per org_id: uniqMergeIf(unique_hotlists, new_status=1 [AND old_status IN (0,90)] | new_status=3) FROM clarity.hotlist_status_aggregate over a month  vs  uniqExactIf(id, first_open_at|first_repossessed_at in month) FROM clarity.hotlist FINAL; FULL/LEFT JOIN on org_id

entries.aggregate_result: Clarity orgs (2,046): first_open_at 1,823,838 vs Accepted 1,791,172 (1.018) vs all Open transitions 1,902,910 (0.958); 207 orgs differ >5%. Repossessions 339,952 vs 340,154 (0.9994), per-org quantiles [1,1,1]. Unrestricted fleet ratio 0.35 was entirely 6 non-Clarity orgs (~10M hotlists each, absent from clarity.orgs, excluded by hotlist_incremental_mv's WHERE h.org_id IN clarity.orgs).

entries.query_shape: SELECT uniqExact(id) FROM clarity.hotlist FINAL WHERE org_id=? AND _peerdb_is_deleted=0 AND created_at < ? AND [branch_id=?] AND first_open_at in 12-month window
entries.param_classes: one large org (top-10 by volume), 12-month window
entries.aggregate_result: 2,016,392 rows read / 55.4 MB / 63 ms / 51 MB memory (vs 4.6-4.7 GB for the status-log route measured 2026-09-02)
entries.why: Cost of the first_*_at route at production scale for a headline card.

entries.query_shape: SELECT multiIf(old_status IN (0,90),'from_0_or_90','from_other') src, multiIf(first_open_at < s,'before', first_open_at < e,'in_window','other') fo, uniqExact(hotlist_id) FROM zod.public_hotlist_status_log sl INNER JOIN (SELECT id, first_open_at FROM clarity.hotlist FINAL WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted=0 AND first_open_at IS NOT NULL) h ON h.id=sl.hotlist_id WHERE new_status=1 AND sl.created_at in window GROUP BY src, fo
entries.aggregate_result: from_0_or_90 & first-opened-in-Aug 1,790,261; from_0_or_90 & first-opened-before-Aug 1,902; from_other & first-opened-before-Aug 79,242; from_other & first-opened-in-Aug 79,577. One-off diagnostic: 501.8M rows / 7.6 GB / 2.5s.
entries.why: Explains the first_open_at vs aggregate drift exactly: ~81k reopens (first opened before the window) are counted by the aggregate's any-Open count but not by first_open_at (the ~4% low); first opens arriving from a non-0/90 status are counted by first_open_at but excluded by scopeAccepted (the ~2% high).

entries.query_shape: per month: uniqMergeIf(unique_hotlists, new_status=1 | new_status=1 AND old_status IN (0,90) | new_status=3) FROM hotlist_status_aggregate WHERE org_id=?  vs  count by toStartOfMonth(first_open_at | first_repossessed_at) FROM clarity.hotlist FINAL WHERE org_id=?

entries.query_shape: old_status of the FIRST Open transition: status_log sl INNER JOIN clarity.hotlist h ON h.id=sl.hotlist_id AND sl.created_at=h.first_open_at WHERE new_status=1, org 14, GROUP BY old_status

entries.query_shape: Accepted approximation: countIf(first_open_at in month AND NOT any of first_invalid/hold/repossessed/declined/closed_at < first_open_at)
entries.param_classes: org 14 by month; fleet Clarity orgs Aug 2026
entries.aggregate_result: org 14: -7.3% .. -12.4% per month (overshoots: many hotlists go 99 -> 90 -> Open, so an earlier Invalid does not mean the first Open came from Invalid). Fleet 0.9886, 194 orgs off >5%.

entries.query_shape: per_hotlist: groupArrayIf((created_at, old_status), new_status=1), groupArrayIf(created_at, new_status=3) FROM zod.public_hotlist_status_log WHERE hotlist_id IN (org's clarity.hotlist ids) GROUP BY hotlist_id; then per month countIf(arrayExists(x -> toStartOfMonth(x.1)=m [AND x.2 IN (0,90)], opens)), countIf(arrayExists(... repos))

entries.query_shape: daily count()/countIf(new_status) on zod.public_hotlist_status_log; per-org Aug vs Sep transitions; clarity.hotlist repo_date by month and by integration_id; new hotlists per day for integration_id=1; zod.public_integrations names
entries.aggregate_result: Status log is synced (last sync today) - not a CDC lag. Integration 1 = RDN: new hotlists/day fell from ~60-78k across ~1,360 orgs (Aug 27-Sep 1) to ~11-15k across ~330 orgs from 2026-09-02, still low in Oct. RDN repo_date Aug 334,754 -> Sep 59,104 (0.177). Other integrations flat (MCRC 8: 1.008; integ 44: 0.978; VRM 2 new hotlists 164,748 -> 134,165). 554 fewer orgs had any transition in Sep; 35 orgs with >50 Aug transitions went silent.

Directly affects Client Analytics numbers and DEV-2442's RDN-only enrichment candidate pool. Surfaced to human; no ticket created (ask first).

Orgs WITHOUT a key (RDN push feed only): 28/1,455 still active, 763,091 -> 11,025 (-98.6%).

entries.query_shape: zod.public_integrations: versions + FINAL row for id=1; max(_peerdb_synced_at) and rows synced since 2026-09-02 for the whole table
entries.aggregate_result: Table syncs normally (469 rows since Sep 2, last today 13:25 UTC). Integration 1 last written 2026-09-01 18:59:50.875 UTC, status=run, batch_id=156982286 - never since. sqs/rdn_batch.py writes this row (status/batch_id) on every batch, including the no-cases path.
entries.why: ROOT CAUSE (out of scope for DEV-2442): insight_app's RDN batch consumer has not completed one batch since 2026-09-01 18:59:50 UTC. Its loop re-raises every exception without deleting the SQS message (poison-message crash loop) and fails before any DB write on a non-200 from RDN. Cannot distinguish crash-loop vs dead process vs RDN non-200 vs SQS creds without insight_app logs / prod rdn_batch_data. Recovery: replay batches 156982287..current (SQS retention has expired; un-keyed orgs cannot be recovered via the API pull).
